title: AAMAS 2027 - Call for AAAI Fast Track
institution: AAMAS 2027 (International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems)
about: Fast-track route into AAMAS 2027 (3-7 May 2027, Hanoi, Vietnam) for multiagent-systems papers not accepted at the AAAI-27 Main Technical Track that meet the review-score threshold. Submissions due 11 December 2026 AoE; decisions 1 February 2027.
requirements: Paper must have been submitted to the AAAI-27 Main Technical Track and not accepted
Paper must be relevant to the AAMAS research community
Review-score threshold applies (wording differs between sections of the call)
Single PDF uploaded through the AAAI Track submission portal

upskill.name: Building AI Agents & Tool-Using Systems
why: "Autonomous agents and multiagent systems" (field) → "Design single-agent and multi-agent workflows that coordinate specialized capabilities to complete complex software and business tasks."

"Multiagent systems" / "Artificial intelligence" (skills) → "Understand agentic AI concepts including tool calling, planning, memory, state management, iterative execution, and multi-step task completion."
